ambient_events: Somebody comes in, sits down on a cushion, says nothing, and isn't asked.
The rota is amended. Two names swap. Neither of them was here.
A dog comes in, walks the whole room, and goes out again.
description: The biggest single room in the Thornwarren, under a roof of layered plate that somebody has spent thirty years making watertight. There's no door, only a hanging, and the hanging is pinned back in the day. Everyone comes here eventually and nobody is summoned.
name: The Chorus' Den
